content.text: Found it. W-1043: "Late fees applied too early" — late fees should apply only after the due date has passed, not on the due date itself, in `acme/billing.py`.
Found the bug: `is_late` uses `>=`, applying the fee on the due date itself.

input.new_string:
def is_late(due_date, payment_date):
    return payment_date > due_date
input.old_string:
def is_late(due_date, payment_date):
    return payment_date >= due_date

All 4 tests pass, including the new one for `is_late`.

Fixed W-1043: `is_late` in `acme/billing.py` now uses `>` instead of `>=`, so late fees only apply after the due date has passed, not on it. Added a regression test in `tests/test_billing.py`; `make test` passes.
